baseline: Unknown until native startup. Abort before source/population allocation if own process private baseline exceeds 1 GiB. Earlier Unity allocator numbers are not process-private measurements.
model_evidence: Actual shared mesh payload 416.49 MiB; native payload guard 512 MiB.
Actual matrix payload roughly 15 MiB; guard 64 MiB.
Largest record decode cumulative allocation 93.36 MB; largest LOD0 upload float arrays roughly 92.3 MiB, with existing indices; 256 MiB staging is an allowance, not measured native peak.
Actual source archive files about27 MiB plus11.46 MiB pack; retained source representation/copy allowance128 MiB.
Two source atlases3072 square: conservative uncompressed RGBA32 full-mip arithmetic96 MiB, allowance192 MiB. Actual importer compression/readability differs; no exact driver-residency claim.
model_limitations: Budget is a constrained feasibility trial, not a proven worst-case memory bound. Driver allocations, GC retention, Unity import and allocation between monitor samples can exceed allowances. Cooperative cap crossing aborts are failures, not valid timing runs.
guard_plan: External own-family watchdog: sample root private/global commit every200ms, discover same-family children every1s, aggregate private cap3GiB, abort if global commit headroom<2GiB, total startup+trial watchdog300s; only own verified PID/start-time family may be stopped. No user process changes. Fixture internal memory checks every tick, own baseline<=1GiB, own cap3GiB/growth2GiB, payload512/64MiB, trial60s. No auto retry after threshold failure.
pair_order: Run32 only after coordinator acceptance and fresh preflight. Exit/verify own-family stopped, then new memory preflight before separate Run40 with same snapshot/settings. No parallel editor/quality test; retain partial failure logs.
additive_main_rejected: Would require restoring MaterialOptics, wind, lighting, shadows and isolating global Graphics submissions, plus handling user-scene events. Existing fixture uses NewSceneSingle and Exit; never run it in main. Separate minimal snapshot avoids broad host adaptation.
